title: James Software functional context graph
purpose: Compact original synthesis of publicly described product behavior for offline agent use.

scope.included: Functional concepts, workflows, selected public source pointers, and explicit uncertainty labels.
scope.excluded: Support-article content, media, article indexes, scraped records, private provenance, personal data, API contracts, and physical implementation details.

entities.label: Practice
entities.summary: A practice-level configuration context for staff, locations, finance, portals, and integrations.

entities.label: Staff member
entities.summary: A configured user whose functional permissions and professional settings can affect work in the practice.

entities.label: User group
entities.summary: A functional grouping that assigns a staff member one configured permission group.

entities.label: Patient
entities.summary: A functional patient record with status and care-related links; this graph contains no patient records or examples.

entities.label: Insurance check
entities.summary: An optional verification workflow that can retrieve insurance-related information for a patient context.

entities.label: Care trajectory
entities.summary: A treatment and financial context used when working with consultations.

entities.label: Clinical record
entities.summary: A template-backed record with functional status, access, and optional patient publication controls.

entities.label: Record template
entities.summary: A configurable template that can organize clinical-record phases, steps, and tools.

entities.label: Appointment
entities.summary: A calendar item that can be patient, group, or general and can use location and practitioner configuration.

entities.label: Schedule
entities.summary: A planning context used to offer appointments; its physical storage and calculation rules are unknown.

entities.label: Consultation
entities.summary: A recorded care activity that can hold one or more billable performances and may remain incomplete.

entities.label: Tariff list
entities.summary: A configuration of performances and prices used in financial routing.

entities.label: Contract
entities.summary: A configuration that relates organization, period, professionals, declarant, and tariff list.

entities.label: Financial document
entities.summary: A functional invoice or declaration output built from consultation performances and route conditions.

entities.label: Patient portal
entities.summary: An authenticated patient-facing surface with selectively published information or actions.

entities.label: Appointment portal
entities.summary: A patient-facing scheduling surface described as operating without a portal login.

entities.label: Integration
entities.summary: A practice-configured online service or API-facing connection; this graph does not define endpoint or token mechanics.

relationships.summary: A practice configuration context is inferred to manage its configured staff.
Each staff member is assigned one user group.
A patient can be associated with care-trajectory context; cardinality is not asserted.
The patient view functionally manages clinical records.
A clinical record is described as template-backed.
Patient appointments include a patient; group appointments can involve more than one.
Appointment proposals depend on scheduling conditions; no internal scheduling data model is asserted.
A care trajectory supplies treatment and financial context for consultations.
Consultation performances can create declaration or invoice routes when conditions are complete.
A contract configuration includes a tariff-list association.
Patient portal access and publication are deliberately configured.
Online services are configured from the practice context.

claims.statement: An incomplete consultation can remain in a holding state rather than immediately producing a financial output.
Patient-facing publication is selective rather than implied by staff access.
Offered appointment slots are logically constrained by configured proposal conditions, not modeled here as freely chosen timestamps.
The public API overview describes practice-bound access and selected functional capabilities, but it does not establish an endpoint or authorization specification.

unknowns.statement: No database engine, table, column, primary key, foreign key, index, ORM model, or migration is represented or implied by this graph.
No backend language, framework, cloud provider, hosting topology, queue, encryption design, retention policy, or network architecture is established here.
No API endpoint list, request or response schema, token format, rotation policy, rate limit, webhook design, or complete authorization model is established here.
